arms.candidate: same base + adapter trained on verified fit-split repairs only
arms.deterministic_random: same base + adapter trained on an equal number of unverified fit-split attempts (pool-matched, includes failing ones)
arms.fixed_policy: same base, k=4 verified fit repairs retrieved by module similarity as few-shot, no training

decision_rule: Pass iff candidate minus each of the three other arms has paired-bootstrap 95% lower bound >= min_effect_micro/2 and mean >= min_effect_micro, in at least 2 of 3 seeds, retention holds. Fail if any contrast mean < 0 or retention breaks. Otherwise Inconclusive (never positive). n_assess is small, so Inconclusive is the expected outcome unless the effect is large; per_module may be raised only in a NEW experiment id.
domain: this repository, caduceus/*.py injected structural-bug repair (family "structural": stmt_delete, return_none, arg_swap, if_negate); oracle = covering unittest modules green, only the target file changed
falsifier: if the pool-matched unverified adapter matches the verified one (difference lower bound <= 0), verification added nothing and the recursion thesis is not supported in this domain
hypothesis: Bug-class generality: the verification effect (verified adapter above pool-matched unverified, untouched base and fixed policy) recurs on structural bugs (statement deletion, return value dropped, call-argument swap, negated condition), a different mutant family from the syntactic one used in exp-011..018.
known_limits: single domain and single base model; replication in a second model is a separate experiment
proposer is a stronger model than the trainee: this tests verified-data distillation, not self-improvement
structural mutants are still synthetic injections, not bugs mined from history
the oracle audit (tasks/bugtasks-v1.audited.json) covers the syntactic family only
leakage_controls: assess tasks never rendered to any proposer or trainer
mutated assess sources not written to disk; regenerated at eval time from (module, op, ordinal)
tests directory unwritable by repair (verifier refuses other files)
oracle_audit: tasks/bugtasks-v1.audited.json (mutant kill rate by operator); survivors are what the oracle cannot see and bound the claim
proposer: fit-split attempts from Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct (bf16, vLLM, temp 0.8, K=12) on a gman H100; trainee and evaluated model: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct 4-bit (the trainee with the most headroom in exp-018).
recipe: LoRA rank 8, 16 layers, lr 1e-5, scale 4 (series 1 used lr 1e-4, scale 20 and every adapter, including the pool control, scored below the untouched base). Steps = 3 x examples, batch 1. Training aborts as NotRun if loss exceeds max(2.0, 5 x first-step loss). Recipe fixed before any model run and not tuned on assess.
retention: tune-split pass rate (evaluated for untouched_base and candidate only) must not drop for the candidate versus untouched_base by more than 0.02
round_policy: New bug family, new manifest v8 (split seed 20371017, per_module 16), fresh proposer run, same recipe, rule and thresholds; no tuning. Training data capped at the first 150 distinct verified repairs in digest order (seed-independent), and the pool control is matched to that count. Cite series 1, exp-011/012/015/018 Pass, exp-013 Inconclusive, exp-014 Fail, exp-016/017 Inconclusive. No parent arm.
status: Locked by ledger entry in ledgers/exp-019-bugrepair.jsonl before any model run.
training_floor: >=100 distinct verified fit repairs (<=3 per task); otherwise NotRun.
unit: assess task, one attempt per arm per seed
